name: nDART Project Rules
description: Rules and patterns for nDART project development

api_requests.description: Use fetch for API requests with proper error handling

conventions: Handle errors consistently using try/catch blocks
Use proper error messages and toast notifications
Use proper HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE)
Use proper content types for requests

modal_structure.description: Use consistent modal structure with proper ARIA attributes
modal_structure.template: Modal Title

toast_structure.description: Use consistent toast structure for notifications
toast_structure.template: Toast Title

conventions: Use proper ARIA attributes for accessibility
Include proper modal structure with header, body, and footer
Use consistent button styling and positioning
Include proper form labels and required field indicators
Use proper data attributes for JavaScript functionality
Include proper error handling UI elements

code_style: Use consistent naming conventions for IDs and classes
Include proper error handling and user feedback
Use proper security measures (CSRF, input validation)
security: Always use CSRF protection for forms and API requests
Validate all user input on both client and server side
Use proper content types for requests
Implement proper error handling without exposing sensitive information
Follow the principle of least privilege for user roles
testing: Write unit tests for critical functionality
